newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Concord Land shares 1.53 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Concord Land shares 1.53 times subscribed.

text.p: Concord Land Development Company Limited, a subsidiary of Pacific Concord Ltd, said its new share offer had been 1.53 times subscribed.

The company said in an announcement published on Monday that a total of 859 valid applications had been received under the new issue for a total of 59.34 million shares, equivalent to 1.53 times the total number of 38.76 million shares available.
The applications included 6.24 million shares offered under a preferential offer.
The underwriters said that all shares were offered following a placing of shares to institutions and at an issue price of HK$3.48 per share.
The issue price is at the lower end of the initial range of HK$3.34 to HK$3.96 per share.

Pacific Concord is a diversified trading company, engaged mainly in the manufacturing and distribution of telecommunications products and components, property development and management, and the operation of department stores.
The new company is engaged in property development, mainly retail properties and shopping malls, in major cities in China.
Dealings in the shares are expected to begin on Thursday, November 7, the announcement said.
